packageRules.description: Nextcloud refuses to upgrade across more than one major at a time (34 -> 35 -> 36, never 34 -> 36). Without this, a repository that has fallen behind would be offered a single pull request jumping straight to the newest major, which cannot be applied. One pull request per major keeps the upgrade path walkable.

Predates the shared preset and is kept as-is: upstream publishes both bare tags (34.0.3) and Apache-flavored ones (34.0.3-apache), and this restricts which of them are considered. Note that nextcloud_version in defaults/main.yml holds a bare version - the -apache suffix is appended by nextcloud_container_image_tag - so this only bites if the resolved package name ever becomes library/nextcloud.
